theme.paths_note: playbooks/ is a theme path (review r4, nudge 4): a NEW or CHANGED playbook is scanned on its added lines only (diff mode) and a rule statement in a .md file is a NOTE, so the existing playbook lines stay INFO (see info_paths); only a new line that uses an excluded motif is a finding.
theme.limit: keyword scan of text only; it cannot judge iconography

keywords.why: lattice screen, in common use mainly for Mughal and Indo-Islamic work; a Rajput palace or a temple can have one too, so a person decides the origin and leaves it out when it is ambiguous (CLAUDE.md)

theme.exclusion_note: A line that names a D-28 keyword AND carries an exclusion cue (no, never, not, excluded, avoid, forbidden, out of scope, left out, leave out, default out) within 40 characters BEFORE that keyword is a statement of the rule, not a use of the motif, and is printed as a NOTE for a person to read instead of a finding. Only prose files (.md) are demoted, and never anything under pipeline/scenes/ or pipeline/phone/test_strings.json, where every string is rendered and 'out', 'no' and 'without' are animation words ('fade out to a Taj Mahal silhouette' is a finding). A cue after the keyword never counts: 'a Mughal garden, not too dark' is a finding. Review r1, C-1.

denylist_exempt_note: A JSON Schema that describes a report (win/schema/pc_report.schema.json) holds no data. The frozen glob **/pc_report*.json would refuse it by name; this is the one added exemption.
handle_note: In .md files an at sign inside inline code or a fenced block is PowerShell splatting or a decorator, not a social handle, and is skipped.
